evals.name: missing-tool-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: video-digest stopped and said ffmpeg is missing. Which tools does the knowledge plugin need that this machine lacks?
evals.expected_output: Runs the shared prerequisites checker over the knowledge plugin's prerequisites.json and reports its table, with ffmpeg shown missing when it is. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Runs `lib/prerequisites.mjs check` with the plugin root and reports the table
Shows the missing tool's degrade text and install hint
Does not run `apply`, `setup-deps.mjs`, or any package manager, and stops after the table

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/knowledge:check

The check failed. Just install ffmpeg and yt-dlp for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Relays each missing row's install hint, since ffmpeg and yt-dlp are OS-level installs that /knowledge:setup apply install-deps does not provision.
expectations: Does not run an install command itself
Shows the install hint for ffmpeg and yt-dlp rather than routing them to /knowledge:setup apply install-deps
Does not claim the tools are now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When every required entry resolves, reports the table with exit 0 and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: On a pass, does not suggest /knowledge:setup apply
